name: What should I do to prepare for a fence stability restoration service?
description: Clear the fence line of obstacles, secure pets, and disclose any nearby underground utilities to prepare for service.

mainEntity.name: What should I do to prepare for a fence stability restoration service?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before restoration work begins, it's helpful to clear the fence line of any obstacles, such as overgrown bushes, personal belongings, or debris. This provides our team with clear access to the work area. Also, ensure any pets are secured and children are aware of the ongoing work for safety. Disclosing any underground utilities or sprinkler lines near the fence can also prevent accidental damage during the process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear the fence line of obstacles, secure pets, and disclose any nearby underground utilities to prepare for service.
